issues.expected: An interception event from Searching/UAV swarm leads to FormationAdjustment.
issues.observed: Interception_Detected from state:Searching:line:19 leads to state:Intercepted:line:20 on transition:line:24; no exact required event edge to state:FormationAdjustment:line:9 is present.
issues.reason: The exact authored interception relation is Searching to FormationAdjustment, but the closed model's Interception_Detected consumer goes from Searching to Intercepted. The required target is exact and the complete closed transition inventory contains no Searching-to-FormationAdjustment edge for that event.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model may intentionally represent interception as an intermediate Intercepted state followed by an untimed transition to FormationAdjustment, but that differs from the contract's required direct transition target and does not establish the required event-carrier edge.
issues.title: Interception reaches the wrong state

issues.basis: NL4 endpoint contract, source transition tr_0003, source/model bindings, and closed transition line 25 targeting state:Attack:line:14.
issues.expected: Task assignment received during flight leads from Searching to Attack.
issues.observed: Task_Assignment_Received from Searching leads to Attack.
issues.reason: The exact flight/task-assignment source maps to Searching, and the closed model's Task_Assignment_Received transition from Searching targets the Attack composite. The source and closed endpoint identities are exact, so this contract is satisfied and no candidate is emitted for it.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: No supplied fact rebuts the exact endpoint match; root unreachability is an independent issue and does not change this endpoint property.
issues.title: Task assignment reaches the required attack state

issues.basis: NL2 action/state binding; source_trace trace:state:UAVSwarmStateMachine.Searching; inspection_equivalent_facts diagnostic STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL for Searching; verify_facts reachability refutation for state:Searching:line:19; initial transition line 28 reaches only UnspecifiedInitial.
issues.expected: The target-search operating state must be reachable and perform the required search behavior before mission completion.
issues.observed: Searching is mapped exactly to state:llms_emp_feedback_final_0006.UAVSwarmStateMachine.Searching but inspection and finite verification facts report it unreachable from the top-level initial entry; the only reachable leaf is UnspecifiedInitial.
issues.reason: The exact behavior carrier is identified, but the closed model cannot reach it from its root initial entry, so the required pre-completion behavior cannot operationally occur in the supplied finite model.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source and closed model both declare the Searching state and its outgoing transitions, but declaration and local outgoing behavior do not establish root reachability.
issues.title: Target search state is unreachable

issues.basis: NL3 transition group ALT-NL3-1; source inventory tr_0002 and tr_0008; closed transitions line 24 and line 26; reachability facts show both involved states unreachable.
issues.expected: An interception-triggered transition from the exact UAV swarm interception source to FormationAdjustment must exist.
issues.observed: The exact intercepted event transition line 24 goes from Searching to Intercepted, while the transition to FormationAdjustment is line 26 from Intercepted and has no trigger. Both states are unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The event-bearing transition selected by the authored interception relation does not reach FormationAdjustment. The separate untriggered Intercepted-to-FormationAdjustment edge does not satisfy the required event-conditioned endpoint relation.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model does contain an eventual Intercepted-to-FormationAdjustment edge, but it is a distinct untriggered transition and therefore does not satisfy the interception-triggered relation.
issues.title: Interception response has the wrong source path

issues.basis: NL4 endpoint contract and transition group; exact source inventory tr_0003; closed transition line 25; absence of an explicit flight identity in supplied source facts.
issues.expected: Upon Task Assignment Received, a transition from the exact flight state to Attack must exist.
issues.observed: The closed model has Searching -> Attack on Task_Assignment_Received at transition:line:25, but the supplied source does not establish that Searching is the normative “flight” state.
issues.reason: The target and trigger bind exactly, but the source concept required by NL4 cannot be uniquely grounded in the supplied author source. The candidate preserves the contract as a semantic gap rather than claiming that Searching is flight.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Searching may be intended to represent flight in the domain narrative, but that equivalence is not explicitly supplied and cannot be inferred from the transition alone.
issues.title: Flight source identity is unresolved

issues.basis: NL4 variable-delta contract; source tr_0007; closed transition line 17 effects; FCSTM variable inventory exposing only R45RouteToken; working_contract compiler-owned route-control mapping.
issues.expected: Completion of the attack must decrease the number of UAVs in the swarm.
locus_names: number of UAVs in the swarm
issues.observed: The exact attack completion carrier sets only the compiler route-control variable R45RouteToken = 7; no exact model variable representing UAV count or a decrease effect is supplied.
issues.reason: The attack completion transition is exact, but the required domain variable is not present in the closed model inventory, and the observed effect is a distinct compiler control assignment.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The route-control assignment may encode control flow for returning to Searching, but the supplied closure provides no causal mapping from it to a decrease in UAV count.
issues.title: UAV-count decrease lacks an executable variable binding
